cmd: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -match 'DcCloneServer|CloudCmdPollerGH|CloudCmdPoller'} | Select-Object TaskName,State,LastRunTime,LastTaskResult | ConvertTo-Json ; Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'CloudCmdPollerGH' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue ; Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'CloudCmdPoller' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
